name: Kalpataru Ltd
title: Kalpataru Ltd - 544423 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Real-estate developer with record FY26 pre-sales of INR 5,280 cr (+17%) and collections of INR 4,960 cr (+34%); no FY27 numeric guidance yet, net debt held at about INR 8,100 cr.

triggers.label: FY27 guidance deferred
triggers.quote: we would come back with the formal guidance for FY'27 at a subsequent date

triggers.label: Q4 pre-sales record INR 1,833 cr
triggers.quote: highest ever quarterly pre -sales of INR 1,833 crores

triggers.label: Net debt not to rise in FY27
triggers.quote: it will be ensured that the net debt level surely does not go beyond what it is today as of March'26

guidance.quote: We have a target of delivering roughly 5.5 million square feet in FY '27.

guidance.value: 5 million sq ft, GDV INR 7,800 cr
guidance.quote: we have an exciting pipeline of new launches of 5 million square feet, amounting to a total GD V of INR 7,800 crores.

guidance.value: not above March'26 level (~INR 8,100 cr); D/E below 2x
guidance.quote: it will be ensured that the net debt level surely does not go beyond what it is today as of March'26.
we would come back with the formal guidance for FY'27 at a subsequent date.

red_flags.label: Operating cash flow thin vs debt
red_flags.quote: the debt levels which are currently at INR 8,100 crores

evasions.topic: Construction cost and CAPEX for new BDs
evasions.quote: We can provide you the data. You can connect with us later because again it is a project by project.
